title: Utexo Opens Utexo Mint Early Access for USDT on Bitcoin Ahead of November 28 Launch
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Utexo Opens Utexo Mint Early Access for USDT on Bitcoin Ahead of November 28 Launch Utexo has opened Utexo Mint, letting verified professional operators test minting, confidential transfers, and redemption of USDT on Bitcoin via RGB ahead of the November 28 public launch. This post Utexo Opens Utexo Mint Early Access for USDT on Bitcoin Ahead of November 28 Launch first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .
